case.believed: Subclassing requests.adapters.BaseAdapter is enough to make Session.send usable, and a custom send method may accept only the PreparedRequest because Session handles transport options itself.
contract: BaseAdapter.send is an unimplemented transport boundary and raises NotImplementedError even when given a valid PreparedRequest.
A subclass that inherits BaseAdapter.send still raises NotImplementedError when mounted on a Session; BaseAdapter supplies no default HTTP transport.
Session.send always calls the mounted adapter with a PreparedRequest plus stream, timeout, verify, cert, and proxies keyword arguments, so a send(self, request) override raises TypeError.
A correctly shaped custom adapter receives caller-supplied transport options unchanged and can return a complete Response without DNS, sockets, TLS, or an external service.
Session.send returns the adapter's Response, preserves its request and URL association, and records elapsed time after the adapter call.
case.goal: Implement and verify the requests 2.34.2 BaseAdapter.send boundary without assuming the base class transports requests or that Session hides transport keyword arguments.
